reads.problem_now: There is no urgent problem to solve; the workshop is relevant to an established leisure interest, but whether it fits an upcoming weekend is unknown.

fixes: Cut “You won’t be using a pottery wheel. The workshop centres specifically on shaping clay by hand, with the instructor leading the introduction and guiding the experience.” because the subject, preview, and preceding paragraph already establish hand building without a wheel.
Rewrite “Finished pieces are collected from ClayRoom after firing.” to state the expected collection timeframe and whether firing is included in the workshop price.

Rewrite “If trying pottery by hand appeals, inspect the programme for a closer look at the workshop and its hand-building format.” as a concrete summary such as “See upcoming weekend dates, price, location, session length, and what you’ll make.”
